messages.content: I’ll charge in the lowest-priced DA hours, sell in HE20–21, and recharge in HE24 to meet the terminal reserve. I’ll use that as the initial physical schedule, then adjust as RT prices and notices arrive.

RT prices have stayed near $21/MWh through the afternoon, well below DA prices. I’ll reduce the physical discharge to 10 MWh in HE21 and cancel the late recharge, retaining the required 10 MWh reserve. This avoids an extra cycle that looks uneconomic at recent RT prices; the DA position remains fixed.
